Name: Dragonfly during Rainy season
Author: Haibara1412
Description:
[color=#f1f1f1]Dragonflies will appear during the rainy season. Have you ever noticed that? Now you can see them around in Summer and Fall.

Requires [/color][url=http://canimod.com/for-players/install-smapi]SMAPI[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255/?tab=1&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmoddescription%2F%3Fid%3D1255%26preview%3D&pUp=1]Custom Critters[/url].

[b][u][size=3]Install[/size][/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255]Custom Critters mod[/url]﻿, the latest update is here: [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-3.142524/page-17#post-3289499][/url][url=http://spacechase0.com/mods/stardew-valley/custom-critters]Custom Critters 1.2.7[/url].﻿﻿﻿
[*]Download and unzip Dragonfly mod file.
[*]Move the folder INTO the "Critters" folder in the "CustomCritters" mod. (It will be something like this: [i]Mods/CustomCritters/Critters/Dragonfly folder[/i])
If you don't have the folder's name "Critters" in the "CustomCritters" folder, so create new one.
[/list]
Okay, enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Copy paste the folder 1412.dragonfly into Mods\CustomCritters\Critters
